items.title: Rebuilding after the strike on Nuseirat
items.summary: Eight people sharing two rooms since their building came down. They need materials to make it weatherproof before winter, and food while the father looks for work.

items.title: Cancer treatment and the journey to reach it
items.summary: Amal's treatment is available, but the travel and the permits cost more than the treatment does. This covers both, and the months she cannot work.

items.title: Keeping three children in school
items.summary: All three were in school before. Fees, books and transport are what stand between them and going back.

items.title: A winter that has already started
items.summary: Six people, one of them ninety-one. Heating, bedding and closing the gaps in the walls before the temperature drops further.

items.title: Insulin, and a fridge to keep it in
items.summary: Two diabetic adults in a house with intermittent power. The cost is the medicine, and a way to store it safely.

items.title: Rent arrears and a way back to steady ground
items.summary: Reem was the only earner until the workshop closed. They are four months behind and have been given notice.
